articles.title: Binance says its European regulatory application is compliant despite report of Greek rejection
articles.snippet: An EU crypto license application by the world’s largest crypto exchange is set to be rejected by the Greek regulator HCMC, according to a report from Reuters.

articles.title: Bitcoin rallies after Japan rate increase with XLM, INJ, UNI advancing
articles.snippet: Stellar’s XLM, Injective’s INJ and Uniswap’s UNI ranked among the best performers in the 100 biggest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization.

articles.title: Hyperliquid loses Anthropic, OpenAI markets as creator shuts down project
articles.snippet: Ventuals, one of the teams behind real-world asset perpetuals on Hyperliquid, said it is closing its markets and joining another project in the ecosystem.

articles.title: If America wants to lead in crypto, it must protect the people who build it
articles.snippet: Despite the Clarity Act’s advancement toward the finish line, there’s one provision under threat for builders that can’t be overlooked, argues Smith.

articles.title: Robinhood cuts 10% of workforce as Tenev touts business strength
articles.snippet: Robinhood cuts about 10% of staff as CEO Vlad Tenev says business “has never been stronger” despite weak Q1 trading.
